en.title: O Come, All Ye Faithful
en.author: Latin, attr. John Francis Wade
stanzas:
[G]O come, all ye [D]faithful,
[G]Joyful and [C]tri[G]umph[D]ant,
[Em]O come ye, [D]O come [G]ye,
[D]To [G]Beth[D]lehem.
[Bm]Come and be[Am]hold [G]Him,
[D]Born the [G]King of [Am]an[D]gels;

Lo! star led chieftains,
Magi, Christ adoring,
Offer Him incense,
Gold, and myrrh;
We to the Christ Child
Bring our hearts' oblations.

Child, for us sinners
Poor and in the manger,
We would embrace Thee,
With love and awe;
Who would not love Thee,
Loving us so dearly?
en.chorus:
[G]O come, let us a[D]dore [G]Him,
[G]O come, let [C]us a[G]dore [D]Him,
O [C]come, let [A7]us a[D]dore [C]Him,
[D7]Christ the [G]Lord.

notes: Text: the Cyber Hymnal's full seven-stanza Oakeley translation (Wade's four Latin stanzas plus the three usually credited to Étienne Borderies). Most hymnals print only stanzas 1, 2, 3 and 7, and hymnary's representative text is those four; stanza 2 is also very widely printed in the variant 'God of God, Light of Light, / Lo, He abhors not the Virgin's womb; / Very God, begotten, not created'. Stanzas 4–7 do not share stanza 1's syllable counts, so a shell reusing stanza 1's chart will not line up on them. Tune ADESTE FIDELES; hymnary's tune page gives A, but the Cyber Hymnal's own setting (and MIDI, mid/a/d/e/s/adeste_fideles.mid) is in G, which is also the first-preference guitar key, so G is used untransposed and the chart is read straight off that MIDI — all six stanza lines and all four refrain lines align exactly with the melody onsets. Chart corrected 2026-08-02: the refrain as first transcribed ended phrases on Em and ended the hymn on D (V) at 'Christ the Lord'; two independent published charts in G (hymnal.net/en/hymn/h/85 and traditionalsongs.org/o-come-all-ye-faithful.html) agree the refrain runs G/D, then C-G-D, then C-A7-D-C, then D7-G, and that 'triumphant' cadences on D — the refrain and that cadence now follow them. Text cross-checked 2026-08-02 against hymnsandcarolsofchristmas.com (a Brooke-based edition: 'Jesu, to Thee be glory given', 'Sing, all ye citizens', 'Lo! Star-led chieftains') — structural agreement, wording variants as expected between editions; this file keeps the Cyber Hymnal's Oakeley text.
